market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH at $2,330 on May 7, 2026. Resolution period covers Nov 24, 2025 - Dec 31, 2026. ETH already hit $1,840 (Feb 2026 low). $1,500 requires another 18% drop from that low or 36% from current. Plausible in a bear market over remaining 8 months but not the base case given recent recovery; market 0.415 looks rich.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Crypto bear market deepening or ETH-specific liquidation cascade.
